description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted in the plot: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.03, which starts at approximately 0.16 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 23; an orange dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average value of 0.44, which begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines to around 0.2 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 from layer 11 to 23; and a green dash-dot line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average value of 0.33, which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.1 at layer 10, and then remains relatively stable, ranging from 0.1 to 0.15, from layer 11 to 20 before dropping to around 0.05 at layer 23.
